name: Customer / counterparty beneficial ownership
description: Who ultimately owns or controls the parties you transact with. Foundation of every FCP regime.

name: PEP / sanctions exposure on counterparties
description: Customers, suppliers, agents, owners screened against PEP and sanctions lists.

name: Cash-payment touchpoints
description: Any inbound or outbound cash flow across the EU 10k EUR threshold (lower thresholds in some member states).

name: Counterparty + transaction records
description: Records you hold to demonstrate CDD, monitoring, screening, training, escalation.

name: Suspicion-raising pathway
description: How a member of staff (or the owner) reports suspicion to the FIU / NCA.
